MATHUR, J.] B Motor Vehicles (New High Security Vehicle Registration Plates) Order, 2001--Clause 4(x)-Selection of single manufacturer for High Security Vehicle Registration Plates (HSVRP) for motor vehicles for as selection of single manufacturer creates monopoly in his favour-Eligibility conditions mentioned by various State Government also quashed-Furthermore, Central Government cannot issue Order of 2001 in exercise of power under section 109(3), as such D ultra vires-Per Rajendra Babu, J.: No
